needed.evidence: footway is under 1m and partly blocked by obstructions
needed.suggestion: Widen and pave the footway to a minimum of 1.5m width and ensure it is clear of obstructions.

needed.evidence: footway is partly blocked by parked vehicles or other obstructions
needed.suggestion: Install bollards or other barriers to prevent vehicles from parking on the footway.
Repair and resurface the footway to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: no dropped kerbs at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to facilitate safe pedestrian movement.

needed.suggestion: Add high-visibility crossing signs and enhance lighting to improve crossing visibility and safety.
